items.section: Assistance for land and other loss
conditions: Thickness of sand/silt deposit is more than 3 inches, certified by the competent authority of the State Government
No other assistance/subsidy has been availed of or is eligible under any other Government Scheme
notes: The rate of Rs. 18,000 per hectare applies for each item (de-silting of agricultural land, debris removal in hilly areas, fish farm repair)
items.summary: Agriculture - Small and marginal farmers (landholding: up to 2 hectares): De-silting of agricultural land. Assistance: Rs. 18,000 per hectare. Minimum assistance: Rs. 2,200 per farmer.
